{{Quote|&hellip; the great god, Yun-Yuuzhan, who shaped the universe from his body.|[[Vua Rapuung]]|<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory I: Conquest">''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory I: Conquest]]''</ref>}}
'''Yun-Yuuzhan''', the '''Cosmic Lord''', was the Creator [[Yun'o|God]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], and their chief deity.

==Mythology==
According to legend, Yun-Yuuzhan sacrificed his body parts to form the universe, the lesser [[Yun'o|gods]], and the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. In honor of his sacrifices, the Yuuzhan Vong in turn sacrificed body parts&mdash;and living beings&mdash;in remembrance of his act of creation. He was revered formally on the holiest days on the Yuuzhan Vong calendar; such dates were the occasions on which rites and sacrifices devoted to him were conducted.

Furthermore, according to the Yuuzhan Vong beliefs, the creator god contained all knowledge of the universe which he kept to himself. However, he was robbed of some of this information by [[Yun-Harla]] who in turn provided it to [[Yun-Ne'Shel]] and she gave it to the Yuuzhan Vong. Thus, the [[shaper caste]] believed that knowledge was incapable of being created and that innovation was considered heresy.

The Yuuzhan Vong were named for him, and it was a sacrilege to simply refer to them as "[[Vong]]" (which many in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] did). Only the [[Supreme Overlord]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] could address him, and the Supreme Overlord was ritually scarred and modified to resemble Yun-Yuuzhan.

Yun-Yuuzhan was based on [[Yuuzhan'tar]], the sentient [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the Yuuzhan Vong. The [[Order of Yun-Yuuzhan]] were a religious body that were named after the Cosmic Lord.
